'''Iwafune Shrine''' (磐船神社, Iwafune-jinja) is a [[Shinto shrine]] located in {{ill|Katano|en|Katano|qid=Q819646|lt=Katano City|1=Katano}}, {{ill|Osaka Prefecture|en|Osaka Prefecture|qid=Q122723|lt=Osaka Prefecture|1=Osaka Prefecture}}. Situated along the gorge of the {{ill|Amanogawa (river)|en|Amanogawa (river)|qid=Q11443656|lt=Amano River (Osaka)|1=Amanogawa (river)}}, it is known for its sacred object, the "Heavenly Rock Ship" (天の磐船), a boat-shaped megalith. The shrine is also referred to as Iwafune Shrine (岩船神社) or Iwakoro Shrine (岩所神社).
